name: Juan Ramirez
bio:
Juan Ramirez, stationed in Alhambra, United States, is an expert tattoo artist renowned for his unique styles in black & gray and realism artwork. Esteemed for his commendable skill level, Ramirez consistently crafts intricate designs with stunning detail, impressively bringing realistic visuals to life on skins. He houses his talent at his studio located at 3480 E. Orangethorpe Ave, Anaheim, deservedly earning recognition in the mainstream tattooing scenes.
